name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: Application menus along the top of a window.

motionProfile.reason: Menubar owns the bar entrance plus the bar and trigger paint, while each open menu keeps dropdown-menu's anchored shell, row palettes and selection marks.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Menubar owns one independent bar insertion: a short opacity entrance on the bar root, with no travel, scale or resting opacity.

popup.anchored/one-shot.reason: Menubar mounts dropdown-menu for popup opening; that installed component remains the integration owner.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Menubar owns the retained bar's own opacity exit, completed through the enclosing presence, with no inherited entrance delay.
Menubar mounts dropdown-menu for popup closing; that installed component remains the integration owner.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: Each open menu shell is dropdown-menu's measured popup; menubar adds no second strip or popup measurement.

state.color/css-transition.reason: The bar root and every top-level trigger own one scoped paint family each, so open and highlight feedback stays local to the bar.
Menu rows, shells, labels, shortcuts and separator rules keep dropdown-menu's scoped colour owners exactly once per mounted surface.

state.morph/one-shot.reason: Menubar mounts dropdown-menu for local state/glyph feedback; that installed component remains the integration owner.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A plain top-level trigger label is menubar's own display slot, so only changed graphemes are replaced.
Menu item, checkbox, radio, submenu, label and shortcut strings keep dropdown-menu's own changed-run display slots.
